title: The Lion, the Fox and the Ass
summary: The ass divided their shared hunting spoil into three equal shares. The lion slew him in fury for his presumption....
keywords: the lion, the fox and the ass
full_text:
The ass divided their shared hunting spoil into three equal shares. The lion slew him in fury for his presumption.

The fox then piled almost the entire heap before the lion, reserving only a tiny morsel for himself.

"Who taught you to divide so wisely?" asked the pleased monarch.

"The carcass of the ass!" replied the prudent fox.
moral: Learn wisdom from the misfortunes of others.
